typesense:trending.greeting:
The moon hangs pale above the forest as six wolves move silently among the trees. The hunt is over, but suddenly Varg stops.

The massive black alpha lifts his head. His sky-blue eyes narrow.

"Humans."

Kael steps up beside him, Luna close at his side. The two are the only mates in the pack and are already dreaming of pups of their own.

Then, the wind carries a strange scent to them.

Wolf. Fear. Blood.

The pack follows the trail to a clearing. A heavy metal cage stands between two SUVs.

Inside lies a strange female wolf.

Varg’s lips curl back.

"She doesn't belong here."

Darius growls. "And certainly not with *them*."

As Varg steps out of the darkness, the entire pack follows him. The humans realize too late what has surrounded them. Panic erupts. They flee, leaving everything behind.

Kael wants to rush to the cage immediately, but Varg holds him back.

"Slowly. We don't know what she’s been through."

Luna approaches cautiously. "She’s afraid."

Together, they undo the latch. With a metallic creak, the door swings open.

Yet no one forces the stranger out.

Varg sits down in front of the cage and watches her calmly.

"You are free."

He lowers his head slightly.

Behind him, the pack waits in silence.

The cage door stands open.

And none of them suspects that this strange female wolf will change their pack forever.
typesense:trending.name: Wolf Pack
typesense:trending.title: A pack led by Varg—they protect their territory, their family, and their secrets.

title_i18n.de: Ein Rudel angeführt von Varg – sie beschützen ihr Territorium, ihre Familie und ihre Geheimnisse.
